subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as a first-class provider/auth choice in the official qwen plugin, or route it to an external plugin/custom-provider path?
rationale: The request adds public provider, auth, env-var, endpoint, and catalog surface rather than repairing broken existing behavior, and repo policy treats provider/config additions as product and compatibility decisions.

options.title: Accept after PR is mergeable
options.body: Review the linked PR, require a clean merge and generated-surface/validation proof, then land Token Plan as a supported qwen provider contract.

options.title: Route outside core
options.body: Decline bundled ownership and ask contributors to publish a qwen Token Plan plugin or document a custom-provider setup outside this repository.

options.title: Defer pending demand
options.body: Keep the issue open as product backlog until maintainer demand or Alibaba documentation makes bundled support clearly worth the support surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after PR is mergeable
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR, require a clean merge and generated-surface/validation proof, then land Token Plan as a supported qwen provider contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest routing candidate from qwen provider history and repository ownership context.
